candidateTerms.title: Terms of Service
candidateTerms.intro: These Terms apply to candidates using Housemaid-AE to find domestic work in the UAE. By creating a profile, you agree to the rules below.

yourProfile.heading: 1. Your profile
yourProfile.body: You own the content you submit — including your photo, intro video, documents, work history, and bio. By publishing your profile, you grant Housemaid-AE a licence to display this information to employers on the platform for the purpose of matching you with job opportunities.

items.documents: Identity and visa documents (for verification only)
items.details: Skills, languages, salary expectations, and availability
items.contact: Contact details (shared only after you choose to engage with an employer)

howWeUseData.heading: 3. How we use your data
howWeUseData.body: We use your profile to match you with employers searching for domestic workers in the UAE. We may show your partially masked name and key details in Discover before an employer unlocks your full profile. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

matching.heading: 4. Matching with employers
matching.body: Employers can browse, save, and message you through the platform. You are free to accept or decline any opportunity. Housemaid-AE does not guarantee employment, interviews, or specific salary offers.

accuracy.heading: 5. Accuracy and conduct
accuracy.body: You agree that all information in your profile is truthful. Misleading photos, fake references, or false visa status may result in immediate removal. Treat employers respectfully in all messages.

deactivating.heading: 6. Deactivating your profile
deactivating.body: You may pause or deactivate your profile at any time. When deactivated, your profile is hidden from Discover and new employer contact is blocked. Existing message threads remain unless you request full account deletion.

deletion.heading: 7. Account deletion
deletion.body: To permanently delete your account and data, contact support@housemaid-ae.com. We process deletion requests within 30 days, subject to legal retention requirements in the UAE.

candidatePrivacy.title: Privacy Policy
candidatePrivacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what we collect from candidates, why we collect it, and how you can control your data.

whatWeCollect.heading: What we collect
whatWeCollect.body: When you create a candidate profile, we collect:

items.contact: Name, phone number, and email address
items.details: Skills, languages, salary expectations, and availability

whyWeCollect.heading: Why we collect it
whyWeCollect.body: We use this information to build your profile, verify your identity, match you with employers, prevent fraud, and improve the platform. Documents are reviewed by our team — they are not displayed publicly.

whoCanSee.heading: Who can see your information
whoCanSee.body: Employers browsing Discover see a partially masked version of your profile. Full details — including unmasked name, complete employment history, and contact information — are visible only to employers who have unlocked your profile or whom you have chosen to message.

howLong.heading: How long we keep it
howLong.body: We retain your profile data while your account is active. If you deactivate, we keep a limited record for up to 12 months. After account deletion, we remove personal data within 30 days except where UAE law requires longer retention.

howToDelete.heading: How to delete your data
howToDelete.body: You can update or remove most information from your profile at any time. To delete your account entirely, email support@housemaid-ae.com from your registered address.

yourRights.heading: Your rights
yourRights.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data. Contact support@housemaid-ae.com and we will respond within 30 days.

employerTerms.title: Terms of Service
employerTerms.intro: These Terms apply to employers using Housemaid-AE to find domestic workers in the UAE. By creating an account, you agree to the rules below.

browsingFree.heading: 1. Browsing is free
browsingFree.body: You can browse verified candidate profiles on Discover without creating an account. Names are partially masked and employment history is hidden until you unlock a profile.

freeMessages.heading: 2. Free messages
freeMessages.body: After creating a free employer account, you receive 3 lifetime free messages across all candidates. This is a one-time grant — free messages do not reset monthly.

unlock.heading: 3. AED 100 unlock
unlock.body: Once your 3 free messages are used, a one-time AED 100 payment unlocks unlimited messaging. A separate one-time AED 100 payment unlocks a candidate's full profile (employment history, references, and unmasked details). These are not subscriptions and do not auto-renew.

noRefunds.heading: 4. No refunds
noRefunds.body: Unlock payments are non-refundable unless required by UAE law. If you believe you were charged in error, contact support@housemaid-ae.com within 7 days.

responsibilities.heading: 5. Your responsibilities
responsibilities.body: As an employer, you are solely responsible for:

items.labour: Complying with UAE labour and immigration laws
items.checks: Conducting your own interviews and background checks
items.respect: Treating candidates with respect and dignity
items.illegal: Not requesting illegal payments or withholding passports

messagingRules.heading: 6. Messaging rules
messagingRules.body: Do not send spam, harassment, threats, or discriminatory messages. Violations may result in permanent account suspension without refund.

noGuarantee.heading: 7. No employment guarantee
noGuarantee.body: Housemaid-AE facilitates introductions only. We do not employ candidates, guarantee suitability, or mediate employment disputes.

governingLaw.heading: 8. Governing law
governingLaw.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates.

employerPrivacy.title: Privacy Policy
employerPrivacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what we collect from employers. We collect far less data from employers than from candidates.

whatWeCollect.heading: What we collect
whatWeCollect.body: When you create an employer account, we collect only:

whatWeDoNotCollect.heading: What we do not collect
whatWeDoNotCollect.body: We do not collect or store your payment card details. All payments are processed securely by PayTabs, our third-party payment provider. We receive only a payment confirmation — not your card number.

howWeUse.heading: How we use your information
howWeUse.body: We use your name and email to operate your account, send message notifications, and provide customer support. Your location helps us show relevant candidates near you.

noSelling.heading: We do not sell your data
noSelling.body: We do not sell, rent, or trade employer personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

retention.heading: Data retention
retention.body: We keep your account data while your account is active. If you delete your account, we remove personal data within 30 days, except where UAE law requires retention.

deletion.heading: Account deletion
deletion.body: To delete your employer account, email support@housemaid-ae.com from your registered address. Deletion is processed within 30 days.

createProfile.question: How do I create a profile?
createProfile.answer: Sign up with Google, phone, or email, then complete the onboarding steps: basic info, location and visa, experience and skills, photo and video, and review. A complete profile with verified documents gets far more employer views.

employersFind.question: How do employers find me?
employersFind.answer: Employers browse verified candidates on Discover. Your name is partially masked until an employer unlocks your full profile. Employers can filter by role type, location, and availability. Keep your profile active and complete to rank higher.

documents.question: Who can see my documents?
documents.answer: Your ID, visa, and reference documents are never shown publicly. Only Housemaid-AE's verification team reviews them. Employers see a Verified badge once approved — they do not download your raw documents unless you choose to share them in chat.

pause.question: How do I pause my profile?
pause.answer: Go to My Profile → Settings and switch your availability to unavailable, or contact support. While paused, your profile is hidden from Discover and employers cannot send new messages. Existing conversations remain accessible.

delete.question: How do I delete my account?
delete.answer: Email support@housemaid-ae.com from your registered address and request account deletion. We remove your profile, documents, and messages within 30 days, except where UAE law requires us to retain records.

message.question: How do I message a candidate?
message.answer: Browse candidates on Discover — no account needed. When you're ready to message, create a free employer account. You get 3 lifetime free messages across all candidates. After that, a one-time AED 100 unlock gives you unlimited messaging.

unlock.question: How does the AED 100 unlock work?
unlock.answer: AED 100 is a one-time payment per unlock — not a subscription. It unlocks unlimited messaging to any candidate, or full access to a candidate's employment history and references, depending on which action you take. Your 3 free messages are a lifetime grant.

refund.question: Can I get a refund?
refund.answer: Unlock payments are one-time and non-refundable unless required by UAE law. If you believe you were charged in error, email support@housemaid-ae.com within 7 days with your account email and payment reference.

find.question: How do I find the right candidate?
find.answer: Use Discover filters for full-time, part-time, live-in, or live-out roles. Save candidates you like, read their skills and experience, and message those who match your household needs. Verified profiles with intro videos are the strongest signal of fit.
